metadata.title: High-Contrast Halftone Portrait with Graphic Overlays

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast monochrome portrait of a figure wearing a beret, characterized by heavy halftone dot patterns and a singular, vibrant red brushstroke across the eye. The composition includes distressed graphic elements like stars and stripes in the background, mimicking a weathered street poster or underground press aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the mechanical halftone dots and the organic, fluid red paint stroke.
Juxtaposition of the sharp black silhouette against the white negative space.
Integration of symbolic star motifs with the portrait's headwear to suggest a specific ideological archetype.
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white tonal range

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered portrait, slightly angled, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red horizontal paint stroke across the subject's right eye.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red eye-mask, moves down the facial features, then outward to the star motifs in the upper left background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space at the bottom and right edges to balance the heavy black ink of the beret and hair.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with zero mid-tones except for those created by halftone density; the red is highly saturated to pop against the desaturated base.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, black and white portrait of a person in a beret using a coarse halftone dot filter. Include distressed star shapes and horizontal bars in the background. Ensure the image has a grainy, photocopied texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a single, thick, horizontal red paint stroke across the subject's eye area. The stroke should have visible bristle textures and slight transparency at the edges.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone pattern visible in the shadows?
Is the red stroke the only color present?
Is the contrast high enough to eliminate smooth gradients?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness issues
Any unique logo or brand-specific star arrangements

mustAchieve: Authentic-looking paint texture for the red stroke

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no gray tones exist outside of the halftone pattern.
Verify the red stroke looks like physical paint, not a digital shape.
Check that the star motifs appear weathered and integrated into the background.
Confirm the beret silhouette is solid black.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast halftone portrait with a single, aggressive color intervention to create a revolutionary or punk-inspired visual identity.
